groups.label: Hanging & main flowers
groups.blurb: White blooms filling the canopy strands and the ground mounds.

items.role: White hydrangea forming the dense white mounds at the base of the columns.
White roses scattered through the mounds and ground beds.
White baby's breath building the large airy fill of both column structures.
White hanging rice-grass strings dropping from the canopy between the wisteria strands.

groups.label: Greenery & grasses
groups.blurb: Green foliage and grasses threading through the white canopy.

items.role: Soft feathery plumes mixed into the hanging strands for green texture.
Light green feathery pine filling the green layer of the canopy.
Round eucalyptus leaves scattered across the hanging ceiling.
Fountain reed grass adding airy grass sprays through the columns.
